scope: New F9 diagnostic on existing PushT F1 H5 development/calibration. Split development families deterministically into gate-fit24 and diagnostic11; calibration35 is disjoint from gate-fit and diagnostic. Existing readout/model investigations already exposed development, so diagnostic11 is not fresh finaltest. Both gates use the same fixed unsupervised 192-to-8 projection and fixed-alpha ridge, with current frame or nominal predicted endpoint as input; both predict log state-level95thquantile of dense object-error/controller-displacement across training candidates. Gates receive physical labels at fit time; candidatefuture uses native frozen LeWM latent distance. Features, label amount and unequal supervision explicitly disclosed. Gate inference never receives future executed object outcomes. Same non-WM controller/random candidatebank, radius<=.2 and expected-jerk ranking. No online runtime or new physics; require subsequent newly collected finaltest and actual inference cost comparison before deployment claims.
